## What's new

- **Linux AppImage starts again on current distributions.** On Wayland with a recent Mesa (for example Fedora/Nobara 44), the AppImage showed a blank window and quit with "Could not create default EGL display: EGL_BAD_PARAMETER". It carried the build machine's Wayland libraries, which break EGL on newer graphics drivers. It's now built with Tauri CLI 2.12, which leaves those libraries out and no longer forces X11, so the AppImage uses your system's own graphics stack, as the .deb and .rpm already did. Every release now checks that this stays fixed.
  - If your AppImage didn't start, download the new one from this release; the old one can't run its updater. The .deb and .rpm were not affected.
